title.value: Scenario 1.1 - Retrieve all GGZ information of person 'XXX-Bals'

description.value:
Qualification of scenario 1.1 of the Basic GGZ Data Retrieve use case. See [the test file on the Nictiz wiki](https://informatiestandaarden.nictiz.nl/wiki/MedMij:V2020.01/Basisgegevens_GGZ_Raadplegen) for more information.
Scenario 1.1 - Retrieve all GGZ information of person 1
Retrieve zib-Patient instance including the patient's general practitioner and check the request
Send a FHIR search on Patient, including the correct '_include' parameter
Confirm that HTTP header Authorization contains the patient token Bearer 6fc70c51-bdda-422e-9eaa-899fe24c4ef9
Confirm that query parameter 'patient=' was not present to avoid BSNs in the URL.
Confirm that query parameter 'subject=' was not present to avoid BSNs in the URL.
Make sure that the server of the test simulator gives a success response.
Confirm that the server of the test simulator returns a Bundle.
Confirm that the response Bundle contains 1 Patient resource(s).
Confirm that the response Bundle contains 1 Practitioner resource(s).
